- **Worktree:** `C:\Users\sarashera\EMR4-worktrees\raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review`
- **Branch:** `codex/review-context-fabric-bureau-memory-1289f9b8`

## Empirical Test Verification

Executed the complete provider-free test suite:
`C:\Users\sarashera\emr4\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m pytest -q tests/test_raisa_provider_free_practice_context_fabric_bureau_memory_contract.py tests/test_raisa_practice_context_fabric_direction.py tests/test_api_spine_artifacts.py tests/test_bernie_context_frames.py tests/test_ariadne_orchestrator_preflight.py tests/test_agents_acceptance_index.py tests/test_ariadne_agent_error_register.py`

Result: **132 passed, 0 failed** (exit code 0).

## Findings Against Review Criteria

1. **Authority & Identity Boundary:**
   - Candidate schema [`context-fabric-contract.schema.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/orchestration/continuity/raisa-provider-free-practice-context-fabric-bureau-memory-contract/context-fabric-contract.schema.json) enforces `additionalProperties: false` on `ContextNeedCandidate` and excludes principal, role, practice, location, consent, retention, command, write, or raw-audit fields.
   - Authority binding is supplied strictly by authenticated backend context via `build_context_need` and `intersect_context_scope` in [`raisa_provider_free_practice_context_fabric_bureau_memory_contract.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/scripts/raisa_provider_free_practice_context_fabric_bureau_memory_contract.py#L95-L249).

2. **Digest Binding & Closed Schema Objects:**
   - Every object (`ContextNeedCandidate`, `ContextAuthorityBinding`, `ContextNeed`, `ContextScopeGrant`, `BureauMemorySelector`, `BureauMemoryItem`, `ContextFrame`, `ContextFrameSet`, `ContextSelectorTrace`, `ContextWeaveTrace`, `ContextProofreaderTrace`) is closed and bound using canonical UTF-8 JSON sorting with SHA-256 digests (`canonical_sha256`, `seal`, `verify_seal` in [`raisa_provider_free_practice_context_fabric_bureau_memory_contract.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/scripts/raisa_provider_free_practice_context_fabric_bureau_memory_contract.py#L37-L58)).

3. **Scope Narrowing & Deterministic Policy:**
   - `intersect_context_scope` strictly computes list intersections, minimum cardinality limits, minimum byte caps, and UTC half-open time window intersection (`max(starts), min(ends)`). If any mandatory intersection fails, decision falls back to uniform generic `NOT_AVAILABLE` without exposing count side-channels.

4. **Selection & Filtering Contract:**
   - `select_bureau_memory_items` admits only items matching allowed Bureaus, action families, actor relations, outcome codes, current supersession state (`supersession_state == 'CURRENT'`), effective half-open interval (`start <= completed < end`), and `authority_ceiling == 'read_context_only'`. Disallowed optional fields (`opaque_target_ref`) are stripped prior to weaving. Items sort canonically by `completed_at` descending then `memory_item_id` ascending.

5. **Proofreading Gate & Tamper Prevention:**
   - `proofread_same_packet` independently re-validates seals, re-computes digests across need, grant, selector, weave, and frame-set, and re-checks item scope, expiry, supersession, minimisation, cardinality, and byte limits. Resealed out-of-scope or tampered items fail proofreading and set `release_decision: BLOCK`.

6. **Memory vs. Audit Distinction:**
   - Memory frames belong strictly to `recent_collective_work` with `command_authority: false` and `read_only: true`. Memory items are derived lossy read projections, never raw audit rows, SQL queries, identity evidence, current truth, or provider-model memory.

7. **GraphQL Read Extension Composition:**
   - [`practice-context-fabric-read.graphql`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/docs/api-spine/graphql/practice-context-fabric-read.graphql) extends `Query` with a single unmounted read field `practiceContextFabric(candidate: ContextNeedCandidateInput!): ContextFrameSet!`. It adds no Mutation, Subscription, standalone memory root, resolver, or route.

8. **Zero Side-Effect Engine Execution:**
   - AST inspection (`_static_checks`) and pytest assertions confirm [`raisa_provider_free_practice_context_fabric_bureau_memory_contract.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/scripts/raisa_provider_free_practice_context_fabric_bureau_memory_contract.py) imports zero network, database, subprocess, filesystem-write, or provider libraries.

9. **Claim Boundaries & Protected Isolation:**
   - Documentation ([`plan.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/docs/raisa-provider-free-practice-context-fabric-bureau-memory-contract-plan.md), [`design.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/docs/raisa-provider-free-practice-context-fabric-bureau-memory-contract-design.md), [`threat-model-delta.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/docs/security/raisa-provider-free-practice-context-fabric-bureau-memory-contract-threat-model-delta.md)) and acceptance evidence ([`provider-free-acceptance-evidence.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/raisa-context-fabric-bureau-memory-review/orchestration/continuity/raisa-provider-free-practice-context-fabric-bureau-memory-contract/provider-free-acceptance-evidence.json)) claim only provider-free authored-synthetic component behavior. No patient, clinical, product, deployment, release, Pages, or protected-ref boundaries are touched; `docs/branding/` remains excluded and clean.
